_metadata.description: Non-negotiable launch requirements: the binding registry, typed validation, handle discipline, session state, governance enforcement, telemetry, and Act projection ownership.

requirements.title: Runtime binding generation
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST generate callable bindings at session start from the proto descriptor image and the scenario CLI manifests, and MUST NOT require per-scenario integration code for a scenario that ships a manifest.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/bindings/registry_test.go::TestProjectsManifestBoundMethods` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-001]). Given the generated descriptor image and a scenario CLI manifest, the registry yields one callable per manifest-bound Connect method.

Target `api/internal/bindings/registry_test.go::TestNewManifestNeedsNoScenarioCode` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-001]). A manifest added to the fixture set becomes callable without any registry edit, proving zero per-scenario integration.

Target `kernel/tests/test_namespace.py::test_namespace_mirrors_manifest_groups` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-001]). The kernel namespace path matches the manifest group/command shape agents already know from the CLI.

requirements.title: Pre-flight argument validation
requirements.description: When a program calls a binding with arguments that do not satisfy the bound proto method's field contract, the Program Runtime MUST reject the call before issuing any request and MUST name the offending field.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/bindings/validate_test.go::TestRejectsUnknownFieldBeforeDispatch` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-002]). An argument absent from the bound request message is refused with no outbound request issued.

Target `api/internal/bindings/validate_test.go::TestErrorNamesOffendingField` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-002]). The refusal names the offending field so a program can be repaired without reading proto source.

Target `api/internal/bindings/validate_test.go::TestRejectsMistypedAndMissingRequiredFields` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-002]). Wrong-typed and omitted required fields are refused pre-flight, not surfaced as a remote 400.

requirements.title: Handle-based results
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST return operation results as in-kernel handles whose default representation is bounded, and MUST require an explicit materialization call before result data enters the submitter's output.

validation.notes: Target `kernel/tests/test_handles.py::test_default_repr_is_bounded` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-003]). A handle's default representation is bounded regardless of underlying row count or payload size.

Target `kernel/tests/test_handles.py::test_materialization_is_explicit` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-003]). Row data reaches program output only through an explicit materialization call, never via default repr.

Target `kernel/tests/test_handles.py::test_filter_and_aggregate_run_in_kernel` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-003]). Filter, count, and group operations resolve in-kernel without materializing the source collection.

Target `api/internal/programs/materialization_test.go::TestContextBytesPerQueryBudget` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-003]). Pins context bytes returned for a large-result query. This is the acceptance signal for the scenario's core value claim.

requirements.title: Session-persistent kernel state
requirements.description: While a session is live, the Program Runtime MUST preserve kernel variable state across separate program submissions so a later program can reference an earlier program's handles.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/sessions/lifecycle_test.go::TestVariablesSurviveSubmissionBoundary` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-004]). A handle bound in one submission is referenceable by name in a later submission on the same session.

Target `api/internal/sessions/lifecycle_test.go::TestSessionsAreIsolatedFromEachOther` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-004]). State bound in one session is not reachable from another, so concurrent agents cannot observe each other.

requirements.title: Governance enforced at the binding boundary
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST NOT generate a binding for a command whose CLI manifest governance declares run_eligible false, and MUST refuse a binding whose declared effect is destructive unless the session holds an explicit matching grant.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/bindings/governance_test.go::TestRunIneligibleCommandGeneratesNoBinding` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-005]). A manifest command declaring run_eligible false produces no callable at all, not a callable that fails at dispatch.

Target `api/internal/bindings/governance_test.go::TestDestructiveEffectRequiresGrant` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-005]). A destructive-effect binding refuses without a matching session grant and succeeds with one.

Target `api/internal/bindings/governance_test.go::TestGovernanceIsReadNotRedefined` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-005]). Effect and permission vocabulary is read from the manifest contract; the scenario declares no second policy vocabulary.

requirements.title: Typed program telemetry
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST emit a typed platform event for every program submission, binding invocation, and program failure through the shared event bus, so friction analysis reads program evidence without a scenario-local analysis stack.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/telemetry/events_test.go::TestEmitsSubmissionInvocationAndFailureEvents` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-006]). Each program submission, binding invocation, and failure emits one typed event through the shared event bus.

Target `api/internal/telemetry/events_test.go::TestFailureEventCarriesProgramLocator` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-006]). A failure event carries the program id and failing location so friction analysis can trace it without re-running.

Target `api/internal/telemetry/events_test.go::TestNoScenarioLocalAnalysisStack` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-006]). Telemetry is emitted only; no aggregation or ranking happens here. Analysis belongs to agent-manager and meta-optimization-manager.

requirements.title: Act projection ownership
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST serve the Act denominator through the shared space projection verb.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/actspace/space_test.go::TestServesActDenominator` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-007]). The shared space projection verb returns the Act denominator parsed from docs/spaces/act-space.md.

Target `api/internal/actspace/space_test.go::TestMatchesSpacedocContract` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-007]). Output satisfies the shared spacedoc contract meta-optimization-manager reads, including denominator confidence.

requirements.title: Act numerator registry RPC
requirements.description: The Program Runtime MUST expose a binding-registry RPC that reports, per Act operation class, whether every operation it names resolves to a manifest-bound governed binding, so meta-optimization-manager computes the Act numerator live and never stores it.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/actspace/numerator_test.go::TestReportsPerCellBindingResolution` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-008]). The registry RPC reports, per Act operation class, whether every named operation resolves to a governed binding.

Target `api/internal/actspace/numerator_test.go::TestPartiallyBoundCellIsInReach` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-008]). A cell whose operations are only partially bound reports in-reach rather than covered.

Target `api/internal/actspace/numerator_test.go::TestUnresolvableCellKeepsAuthoredStatus` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-008]). A cell that cannot be resolved keeps its authored status and is never fabricated as missing.

requirements.title: Domain measure coverage
requirements.description: Every stateful domain the Program Runtime owns MUST carry at least one declared measure in the CLI manifest, or a `measures.omitted` waiver naming the domain and its reason, so measures-health grades the scenario on a stated position rather than an absence.

validation.notes: Target `api/internal/measures/coverage_test.go::TestEveryStatefulDomainHasMeasureOrWaiver` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-009]). Each domain classified stateful resolves to at least one declared measure or a waiver carrying a reason; a domain with neither fails.

Target `api/internal/measures/coverage_test.go::TestWaiverNamesALiveDomain` (tag the test [REQ:PRT-P0-009]). A waiver pointing at a non-stateful or nonexistent domain is reported as stale rather than silently accepted.
